Roman-inspired tunics, sandals, limewashed masonry, terracotta, bronze collars and ward stones; invented people and symbols only. Entire scene in focus, clear silhouettes, readable at a reduced game-screen scale. No three-dimensional rendering, photography, modern equipment, existing franchise designs, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, panel grid or decorative outer frame.

scenes.arena: A wide tactical overhead action-RPG combat screen seen from almost directly above, like a bird looking straight down: show a broad sandy arena floor, tiny foreshortened figures seen by their heads and shoulders, and only a narrow rim of low arena wall at the edges; no horizon, no visible sky, no frontal standing portraits. The player is a small adult Water mage near the lower centre, facing the upper right, surrounded by plenty of empty navigable sand: her RIGHT hand fires a thin cyan bolt toward a shield-bearing soldier above her, while her LEFT hand sustains a clearly separate cyan crescent on the ground immediately in front of HER feet; an orange orb arriving from the upper right breaks into a tight white spark on that crescent, and the ground behind her stays unshielded. A slinger is far to the left, a cinder hound circles on the right, and a small enemy mage at upper right is the source of the incoming orange orb; keep each figure small enough that its height is less than one tenth of the screen. A black-centred jagged red warning patch lies off to the right, distinct from the cyan casting trail and the player's defensive crescent. Draw compact, readable combat silhouettes and separated effect paths against the broad ground, with sparse Roman stonework and ward posts at the margins and quiet strips at top and bottom for later interface labels.
scenes.camp: A wide overhead illustrated navigation map of the guarded mage camp, a complete walkable enclosure with branching paths and small collared adult inhabitants, no combat or spellcasting. Arrange a staff-training yard at upper left, a dry round cistern at upper centre, a sunken sparring pit at upper right; a market of awnings at middle left, a communal bread table and gathering square at the centre, a monumental barred arena door at middle right; a cluster of patched living tents at lower left, and a fogbound camp boundary with a secluded meeting path at lower right. Leave calm space along the top for the day time-slot strip and along the bottom for destination information; draw only the map, all text and time-slot controls are added in code.
